summary: Scout a short nearby area for reachable logs, then collect the first usable wood found.
rationale: Continue Active Episode episode-cycle-0001: Jun has full vitals but no inventory and no visible logs in the current loaded view. The life goal calls for immediate survival progress from natural resources, so the next useful step is fresh evidence for wood rather than waiting or inventing a crafting prerequisite. A bounded scout can reveal a reachable log or confirm this patch is not the right spot, after which collection can begin.

evidence_required: Runtime evidence of a reachable log or wood item in inventory.
If collection occurs, pickup or inventory delta evidence for logs/planks.

stop_conditions: A reachable log is found or collected.
A short nearby scout fails to reveal a better immediate wood source.
A blocked path or repeat constraint appears for the chosen target.
